milestones.outcome: The source/assets are frozen and the existing compiler has a tested bounded ten-clip contract.
exit_criteria: Live import IDs/baseline and known source drift are recorded without overwriting existing work.
Ten incoming inputs and their actual geometry are inventoried.
Compiler/catalog/geometry fixtures enforce the revised bounds and retain portable PNG comparison.
milestones.boundary: One intake/asset-contract boundary; no production-art or application acceptance implied.

milestones.outcome: One prop-free Dif identity and the complete ten-clip production catalog are accepted and reproducible.
exit_criteria: The master, all real gestures, neutral endpoints, seam, matte and body registration pass.
71-frame target catalog, exact source/digest record and focused art/derivative decision are complete.
milestones.boundary: One art-revision boundary; park only exact human/art waits and continue independent runtime work.

milestones.outcome: Typed profile preferences, native motion resolution and a bounded retained Qt player exist with focused tests.
exit_criteria: Current appearance migration/fan-out and failure behavior are covered.
Observer states are honest, and retained playback/lifecycle is correct with fixture catalog tests.
milestones.boundary: Runtime may proceed independently of final art attendance; fixtures cannot enter the shipped catalog.

milestones.outcome: The real app displays accepted Dif on current Home and respects profile preferences without changing reading state.
exit_criteria: Normal Home/Settings gestures demonstrate greeting, breathing, blink and static rest.
Retained review, compact input layout, profile fan-out, shared cache and inactive timers are verified.
milestones.boundary: One real-app Home integration pass with actual accepted assets.

milestones.outcome: All contextual clips are reachable through the existing explicit AI UI and correct accepted operation facts.
exit_criteria: Every contextual clip has an actual UI/projection route; Dif remains non-authoritative.
Identity/dedup, terminal coalescing, hidden-result suppression and interruption cases pass.
milestones.boundary: One focused contextual integration pass; no new AI/domain effect or live-provider requirement.

milestones.outcome: The complete catalog and application integration have bounded evidence and truthful source/platform/closeout records.
exit_criteria: Focused real-app/native/resource/core-only checks and actual memory/timer/paint observations are recorded.
Required rendered integration decisions are complete or precisely pending, with unchanged evidence reused.
A1–A8/B1–B12 and docs/independent review agree; formal status honors the existing canonical order.
milestones.boundary: One integration-focused completion boundary, not repeated full suites or blanket approval gates.
